raw_text: BSF personnel detected and shot down a Pakistani hexacopter drone near Amritsar on the Punjab international border. The drone was carrying approximately 5 kg of heroin. This is the third drone incursion along the Punjab border in the past week. Anti-drone systems are being deployed at forward posts. Narco-terror nexus under close surveillance.
